metadata.goldstone:source:
# Lines with ticks (evenly spaced bars along the line) and marks # (1–3 bars at one position). Both work on any stroke and line shape. format = 1
[[vertex]] id = "a1" at = [0, 0] [[vertex]] id = "b1" at = [80, 0] [[edge]] from = "a1" to = "b1" ticks = true label = "ticks"
[[vertex]] id = "a2" at = [0, -25] [[vertex]] id = "b2" at = [80, -25] [[edge]] from = "a2" to = "b2" ticks = true tick_spacing = 10 tick_length = 8 double = true label = "double, spacing 10, length 8"
[[vertex]] id = "a3" at = [0, -55] [[vertex]] id = "b3" at = [80, -55] [[edge]] from = "a3" to = "b3" marks = 1 arrow = "forward" label = "1 mark, arrow"
[[vertex]] id = "a4" at = [0, -80] [[vertex]] id = "b4" at = [80, -80] [[edge]] from = "a4" to = "b4" marks = 2 mark_pos = 0.5 stroke = "dashed" label = "2 marks, dashed"
[[vertex]] id = "c" at = [120, -60] kind = "dot" [[vertex]] id = "e" at = [180, -60] kind = "dot" [[edge]] from = "c" to = "e" bend = 70 ticks = true arrow = "forward" label = "arc" [[edge]] from = "c" to = "e" bend = -70 marks = 3 arrow = "forward"
